title: Rank Student 2's Overdue Assignments by Urgency
instruction: Rank Student 2's three overdue assignments by urgency, considering deadline distance, course weight, and current grade impact, before the advisor decides which ones to flag first.
why_tree_of_thoughts: Several defensible orderings exist depending on which factor is weighted most; worth generating and self-scoring a couple of candidate rankings before committing, but a wrong ranking is cheap to redo (no external action taken yet), so self-evaluated lookahead is sufficient.
